responses.question: 故障码 A01007 在手册中表示什么故障？请说明故障现象、可能原因和证据。

answer.text:
结论：A01007 表示“需要为 DRIVE-CLiQ 组件执行 POWER ON（POWER ON for DRIVE-CLiQ component required）” [A01007:E1][A01007:E3]。

依据：
- 故障码为 A01007 [A01007:E1]。
- 故障描述/现象为 POWER ON for DRIVE-CLiQ component required [A01007:E3]。
- 涉及组件为 DRIVE-CLiQ component [A01007:E2]。
- 参数为 r2124 [A01007:E5]；报警值按十进制解释为 DRIVE-CLiQ 组件的组件号 [A01007:E6]。

原因：
- 可能原因为 firmware update [A01007:E4]。
- 当前证据未说明其他可能原因。

建议处理：
- 关闭指定 DRIVE-CLiQ 组件的电源，并重新开启 [A01007:E7]。
- 对于 SINUMERIK，自动调试会被阻止；此时所有组件都需要 POWER ON，并且必须重新启动自动调试 [A01007:E7]。
- 当前证据未说明其他处理措施。

contexts.description: POWER ON for DRIVE-CLiQ component required
causes: firmware update
contexts.alarm_value:
Alarm value (r2124, interpret decimal):
Component number of the DRIVE-CLiQ component.
contexts.remedy:
Remedy: - Switch off the power supply of the specified DRIVE-CLiQ component and switch it on again.
- For SINUMERIK, auto commissioning is prevented. In this case, a POWER ON is required for all components and the auto
commissioning must be restarted.

causes: A DRIVE-CLiQ connection fault has occurred.
Communication via DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100 ... X107 has not been switched to cyclic operation; cause may be an incorrect structure or a configuration that results in an impossible bus timing.
Loss of the DRIVE-CLiQ connection; cause may be, for example, that the DRIVE-CLiQ cable was withdrawn from the Control Unit or as a result of a short-circuit for motors with DRIVE-CLiQ.
Repeated faults when detecting the connection.
A connection was detected but the node ID exchange mechanism does not function; reason is probably that the component is defective.
contexts.alarm_value:
Fault value (r0949, interpret decimal):
100 ... 107:
Communication via DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100 ... X107 has not been switched to cyclic operation. The cause may be an
incorrect structure or a configuration that results in an impossible bus timing.
10:
Loss of the DRIVE-CLiQ connection. The cause may be, for example, that the DRIVE-CLiQ cable was withdrawn from the
Control Unit or as a result of a short-circuit for motors with DRIVE-CLiQ. This fault can only be acknowledged in cyclic
communication.
11:
Repeated faults when detecting the connection. This fault can only be acknowledged in cyclic communication.
12:
A connection was detected but the node ID exchange mechanism does not function. The reason is probably that the
component is defective. This fault can only be acknowledged in cyclic communication.
contexts.remedy:
Remedy: For fault value = 100 ... 107:
- ensure that the DRIVE-CLiQ components have the same firmware versions.
- avoid longer topologies for short current controller sampling times.
For fault value = 10:
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ cables at the Control Unit.
- remove any short-circuit for motors with DRIVE-CLiQ.
- carry out a POWER ON.
For fault value = 11:
- check the electrical cabinet design and cable routing for EMC compliance
For fault value = 12:
- replace the component involved.

causes: OCC cable shield is not correctly connected.
defect in the brake control circuit of the drive.
Fault in 'open brake' operation.
brake not closed or interrupted cable.
ground fault in brake cable.
Fault in 'brake open' state.
short-circuit in brake winding.
Fault in 'close brake' operation.
Fault in 'brake closed' state.
Fault in the brake control of the drive or a communication error (brake control diagnostics).
contexts.alarm_value:
Fault value (r0949, decimal interpretation):
10, 11:
Fault in "open brake" operation.
- brake not closed or interrupted cable.
- ground fault in brake cable.
20:
Fault in "brake open" state.
- short-circuit in brake winding.
30, 31:
Fault in "close brake" operation.
- brake not closed or interrupted cable.
- short-circuit in brake winding.
40:
Fault in "brake closed" state.
50:
Fault in the brake control of the drive or a communication error (brake control diagnostics).
442 Operating Instructions, 01/2019, A5E41702836B AC
contexts.remedy:
Remedy: - select STO and then deselect again.
- check the motor holding brake connection.
- check the function of the motor holding brake.
- carry out a diagnostics routine for the faults involved.
- check for EMC-compliant control cabinet design and cable routing (e.g. shield OCC cable with shield terminal and shield
plate, check the connection of the brake conductors).
- replace drive.
